scope: Requested living-background upgrade across all five maps.

requirements.requirement: All five maps have visible setting-specific background activity.

abyssal_observatory: Schools visibly travel across the lower window and behind the middle fighters; they occupy different positions at every timed sample. High has more fish than Low.

Jellyfish drift and change relative position with trailing filaments, including a cluster behind the center of the stage at 10 seconds. The large dark manta changes its position near the right upper platform.

Fish and jellies remain behind the fighting planes and architecture. The painted whale remains stationary, so this review accepts moving layers around a retained matte rather than claiming every depicted animal is animated.
ember_foundry: The side spillway streaks change shape and position across all four samples in High and Low. Molten highlights remain orange and align with the static lava scene.
High flywheel spokes visibly rotate, while smoke and drifting ember points change position behind the stage. Low reduces machinery/detail while retaining moving spillways and embers.
No bright central lava curtain covers the fighters; platform edge strips and four fighter silhouettes remain legible.
lunar_reach: The six-wheel rover travels left from its initial position between the middle fighters; its roof and wheels remain assembled in High and Low.
The left tracking dish changes aim and spoke orientation between 0 and 10 seconds. Earth surface/cloud detail changes slightly while terrain and stage planes remain stable.
The muted left-edge dish does not cover central exchanges; stage edges remain identifiable against the dark terrain.
rooftop_riot: Pool highlights and wave bands visibly change across timed samples in High and Low, while the pool perimeter remains stable.
A High gull appears above the left upper platform at 2 seconds and has a different position and wing posture at 10 seconds. Guest bodies remain coherent.
The two Low gulls were not visible in the inspected sky crops at sampled timestamps. Low still retains visible water changes and reduced foliage activity.
The sky remains coherent in these fixed normal-camera views. Wide-camera rectangle repair is reviewed separately by the standard-view reviewer.
verdant_shrine: Valley birds appear at different positions across 0/2/5/10-second samples. Mist and localized cascade highlights change in both quality tiers; stone architecture remains anchored.

The revised near waterfall shows long irregular white ribbons, with subtle downstream detail changes. The former strong repeated chevron/V bands are absent in the inspected original-pixel crops and original PNGs.
Fighter silhouettes and pale platform boundaries remain readable. The water treatment does not displace cliff edges or bridge architecture.

requirements.requirement: Ocean fish visibly swim and the lava arena has visible flowing molten material.
Backgrounds remain coherent and fighters, platforms and recovery paths remain readable.
requirements.coverage: 25 inspected 1080p High/Low, overlap, recovery and near-ledge fixtures, all five arenas.

requirements.requirement: Low retains ambient activity; scene motion pauses and resets correctly.
requirements.coverage: 70 reviewed image/state records, 378 assertions, all ten arena/tier cases; pause pairs are pixel-identical and reset stage snapshots match.

requirements.requirement: Existing platform collision, combat behavior, original artwork and preceding release are preserved.
requirements.coverage: 72 preservation checks, 106 original bitmaps, eight supplied originals, eight curated sources and unchanged preceding platform ZIP; 5097 source assertions.

requirements.requirement: Updated Windows build and reproducible editable scene/shader tools are delivered with current validation notes and motion previews.
requirements.coverage: Matching EXE/PCK and 22 fully decoded archive entries; live editable Godot sources, tools and five 12-second 1600x900/60-FPS ambient clips; Windows UI, executable smoke and full-match checks.

requirements.requirement: Performance is measured and material limitations are documented.
requirements.coverage: Ten isolated 60-second 1080p four-CPU High/Low cases at explicit 120 FPS cap, plus two retained repeats. Frame-pacing spikes and the aborted uncapped lost-device run are documented; stable frame pacing or a driver fix is not claimed.

limitations: Sampled assistant visual review does not establish continuous human motion/audio acceptance.
Frame-pacing stalls and the uncapped GPU device-loss crash remain unresolved; this delivery does not claim clean stable 60 FPS.
Human playtesting, physical controllers, weaker-PC, exported-build performance and current Mobile-renderer performance remain unverified.
